fields.title: Calculate the prompt
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Chat assistant: instruction 400 tokens, profile 250, dialogue history grows by 180 tokens per turn, retrieved data 2,000, response 300.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: How many tokens on turn 1, 5, and 15?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: What grows fastest and what to do about it?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: Turn 1 ≈ 2,650 input + 300 output. Turn 5 ≈ 3,370. Turn 15 ≈ 5,170. History grows the fastest — linearly with the number of turns, and it is sent in full every time. Solution: compress the early part into a summary, keep the last N turns in full. Second takeaway: the immutable part (instruction) must come first for prompt caching.
